items.title: F-031 · The district overflow card's names are 22px targets
items.description: Found by Groundskeeper's audit-ui on its first run after taking the F-018 fix: every name on the new district overflow card measures 21.7px drawn. The CSS floor was there — designed 24 — but plane two is drawn at 0.90, and these names are the ONLY way to the districts the row could not hold, unlike the chip's disclosure which sits on a card-sized target. Source: groundskeeper-graview/docs/graview-feedback.md, F-031.
